description: This file contains various interface and class definitions related to Orleans grains, including tests for explicit interface implementations, generic methods, handling of reserved keywords, nested generic types, and static members within grains. It includes test interfaces, grain implementations, and data contract classes.

classes.name: ExplicitInterfaceMethodImplementationTestGrain
classes.description: Implementation of grain with explicit interface method M that is not yet implemented.

classes.name: GrainWithGenericMethods
classes.description: A generic grain class implementing IGrainWithGenericMethods with various generic utility methods.

classes.name: RuntimeGenericGrain
classes.description: A grain class demonstrating storage of '@event' state and methods involving reserved keywords.

classes.name: @event
classes.description: A data class using reserved keywords as identifiers, with equality and hash code implementations.

classes.name: NestedGeneric
classes.description: A generic class with nested class, used for testing nested generic serialization.

classes.name: NestedConstructedGeneric
classes.description: A generic class with a nested class instantiated with a specific type argument.

methods.name: GetTypesExplicit
methods.description: Returns an array of Type objects for explicitly specified generic type parameters.

methods.name: GetTypesInferred
methods.description: Returns an array of Type objects based on inferred generic type parameters.

methods.name: RoundTrip
methods.description: Returns the input value, testing generic method behavior.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Returns default value for a given generic type or a fixed string.

methods.name: Constraints
methods.description: Returns the provided grain object, demonstrating generic constraints.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Gets the stored internal state value.

methods.name: SetValueOnObserver
methods.description: Sets a value on a given observer.

methods.name: ValueTaskMethod
methods.description: Returns a ValueTask with different result based on input parameter.

methods.name: SetState
methods.description: Sets the state in a grain implementing IRuntimeCodeGenGrain.

methods.name: static
methods.description: Returns the current event stored in the grain state.
